result.instructions: Tools for Practice Better, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which client sessions do I have scheduled this week?"; "Find client Jane Smith and show her contact details."; "Which invoices still have an amount due?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Practice Better data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run practice_better_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run practice_better_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run practice_better_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. practice_better_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: practice_better_get_account
tools.title: Get my account
tools.description: The practitioner (API user) behind this connection: id, name, title, timezone, default currency, role flags and the practice (company) id and name. Settings, integrations and the bio are not returned. GET /consultant/profile.

tools.name: practice_better_list_practitioners
tools.title: List practitioners
tools.description: List the practitioners and admin users of the practice, with id, name, role flags and activation status. Use the ids to filter sessions and invoices. GET /company/administration/members.

tools.name: practice_better_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List client records, newest first: id, status, name, email, phone, timezone and activity dates. Date of birth, address, insurance and notes are not returned. A page holds at most 100 records. To look up one person by name or email use practice_better_find_clients. GET /consultant/records.

status.description: Only these statuses. pendingcreate = prospective client, created = added client.

has_account.description: true = only clients with an active Practice Better user account.

child_records.description: true = only sub-records (dependants), false = only primary records.

modified_after.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

modified_before.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.

tools.name: practice_better_find_clients
tools.title: Find clients by name or email
tools.description: Search client records by name, preferred name or email (case-insensitive text match). Practice Better has no search endpoint, so this reads the 500 most recent records (5 pages of 100) and filters them; `complete` says whether every record was checked. Returns at most `max_results` matches with the same fields as practice_better_list_clients. GET /consultant/records.

query.description: Text to look for in first name, last name, preferred name or email.

tools.name: practice_better_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: One client record by id: status, name, preferred name, pronouns, email, phones, timezone, activity dates and tag ids. Date of birth, address, insurance, emergency contacts, notes and health history are not returned. GET /consultant/records/{recordId}.

tools.name: practice_better_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions (appointments)
tools.description: List sessions (appointments), newest first: date, duration, service, practitioner, client (id and name), status and payment status. Booking notes and session notes are not returned. Filter by date range, practitioner, client record, service or group/1-1. GET /consultant/sessions.

date_after.description: Sessions on or after this date-time (ISO 8601 with timezone).

date_before.description: Sessions on or before this date-time (ISO 8601 with timezone).

practitioner_ids.description: Only sessions of these practitioners (ids from practice_better_list_practitioners).

record_ids.description: Only sessions of these client records.

service_ids.description: Only sessions of these services (ids from practice_better_list_services).

group.description: true = only group sessions, false = only 1-1 sessions.

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.

tools.name: practice_better_get_session
tools.title: Get session
tools.description: One session (appointment) by id: date, duration, service, practitioner, client (id and name), location and status. Booking notes and session notes are not returned. For a group session pass record_id to see one client's view. GET /consultant/sessions/{sessionId}.

record_id.description: Group sessions only: the client record id.

tools.name: practice_better_get_availability
tools.title: Get available time slots
tools.description: Open booking slots of one practitioner for one service, starting on the given day: start, end and duration of each slot. It follows the practitioner's booking settings. Needs a practitioner id and a service id. GET /consultant/availability/slots.

day.description: The day to start from, ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-12T00:00:00Z.

type.description: Session type: face (in person), phone or virtual.

package_id.description: Only slots usable with this client package.

tools.name: practice_better_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services (appointment types) the practice offers: id, name, duration, group or 1-1, session types and SKU. GET /consultant/services.

team_for.description: Whose items: self (default), all (all team members) or other (team members except you).

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.

tools.name: practice_better_list_packages
tools.title: List packages
tools.description: List the package definitions (bundles of sessions or programs) the practice sells: id, name and SKU. GET /consultant/packages.

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.

tools.name: practice_better_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags the practice uses to organize clients: id and name. A client record carries tag ids. GET /tags.

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.

tools.name: practice_better_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List client invoices, newest first: number, date, totals, amount due and paid, payment status, client (id and name) and practitioner. Payment history and line items are not in the list; use practice_better_get_invoice. GET /consultant/payments/invoices.

payment_status.description: Only invoices with these payment statuses.

invoice_date_after.description: Invoice date on or after this date-time.

invoice_date_before.description: Invoice date on or before this date-time.

record_ids.description: Only invoices of these client records.

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.

tools.name: practice_better_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id with its line items (date, quantity, amount, tax) and totals. Descriptions, payment history and billing contact are not returned. GET /consultant/payments/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: practice_better_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the form templates of the practice (intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms): id and name only. GET /consultant/forms.

team_for.description: Whose items: self (default), all (all team members) or other (team members except you).

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.

tools.name: practice_better_list_form_requests
tools.title: List form requests
tools.description: List forms sent to clients, newest first: which form, which client (id), practitioner, and whether it was started or completed, with dates. The answers are never returned. GET /consultant/formrequests.

completed.description: true = only completed requests, false = only incomplete ones.

created_after.description: Created on or after this date-time.

created_before.description: Created on or before this date-time.

record_ids.description: Only requests for these client records.

before_id.description: Cursor: pass next_page.before_id of the previous reply to get the next page (lists are newest first).

after_id.description: Cursor for lists in ascending order: return items after this id. Normally use before_id.
